panels.prompt: Wide shot, young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back, running alone along an earthen dam across a misty marsh at dawn, breath steaming; cold blue-grey fog, wet dark wood

Medium shot, exhausted salt miner in sheepskin vest collapsing to his knees in snow under huge ash tree by log tavern door; young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back approaching; dawn mist

texts.text: Ведьмак… Жнец? Я из Гронека… бежал…

panels.prompt: Close-up, gaunt salt miner's face caked in grey salt dust, hollow cheeks, cracked lips, red-rimmed terrified eyes, salt-dusted stubble; cold blue-grey morning mist

texts.text: В копях красные врата. Двоих наших проглотило. И пятерых огненных братьев.

panels.prompt: Extreme close-up, raw cracked bleeding fingers clutching the studded dark leather sleeve of a witcher jacket; snow, cold grey light

texts.text: Бургомистр даёт четыреста крон. На рассвете четырнадцатого — прорвёт.

panels.prompt: Tight close-up, young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back, vertical slit pupils, ash-grey strands over forehead, one short decisive nod; cold dawn light

Wide shot, woman with short light-brown hair, tired grey eyes, round shield with green runes kneeling, binding salt miner's hands with linen strips on bench by log tavern door; half-elf girl with pointed ears peeking from half-open door; morning mist

texts.text: Сиди. Стабилен. В смысле — стабильно плох.
